InteractionSecret.name: Authorization
InteractionSecret.description: Hubuum-Interaction <redemption_secret>; not a normal API bearer.

HumanBearer.description: Existing unscoped human credential; privileged purpose binds this exact credential.

ProviderId.description: Reserved local provider ID or a server-issued immutable external provider UUID.

ExternalProviderId.description: Server-issued immutable UUID for an LDAP, OIDC or OAuth provider; local is not valid here.

Begin.description: Approval requires the existing human bearer and exact operation; verification requires its local-admin owner and candidate_id. BFF requires registered return_target_id and per-login return_nonce. Other combinations are rejected; login cannot carry privileged fields.

redemption_secret.description: Returned once to initiating BFF/CLI; never browser JavaScript.

verification_receipt.description: Returned only to the initiating administrator after all required checks pass; single-use, redacted.

providers.description: Every provider in an authentication candidate, including IDs allocated for new runtime definitions. Use these IDs to begin provider_verification interactions before activation. Empty for authorization candidates.

Membership.description: provider_groups requires claim_source, claim_pointer, key_mode and complete string-array data. Local-group mappings are unsupported. Deployment ceilings apply; max_stale must be >= refresh interval.

OidcDefinition.description: openid scope and S256 required; exact issuer; no algorithm downgrade or caller-selected endpoints. Optional methods/algorithms require explicit qualified adapter support.

OauthDefinition.description: S256 mandatory. Built-in github pins GitHub.com endpoints and lossless integer /id; json_user is one HTTPS bearer-authenticated GET JSON response. Administrator field pointers only; no scripting or arbitrary headers.

BrowserProvider.description: Existing provider IDs are immutable. Omit provider_id only for a new runtime definition; candidate creation allocates it once and reports it for test interactions.

AuthorizationCandidate.description: source deployment references current deployment settings and forbids connection. source runtime with backend treetop requires connection. Local forbids connection. Readiness and recovery administrator proof required; deployment trust/egress/timeout limits apply.
